user.title: Add a Lumae Radio
user.description: Home Assistant usually finds a radio on your network by itself. To add one by hand, enter its web address: in the Lumae app, open the radio's remote and tap ⋯ → The radio; the address is under its name.

data_description.address: For example https://lumae-radio.local:8443. Use the name the radio was set up with: it doesn't answer to other names.

api_key.title: {name}
api_key.description:
Home Assistant found the radio at {web_address}. Its identity is {identity} ({fingerprint}); the Lumae app shows the same under the radio's Access page.

Make an API key for Home Assistant: in the Lumae app open the radio's remote, tap ⋯ → The radio → Access → + New key, or use API access on the radio's web page. Tick **Read** and **Control playback**. Tick **Stations** too if you want to favor, rest and ban tracks from Home Assistant.

data_description.api_key: Starts with lrk. The radio shows it only once.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The radio no longer accepts the API key Home Assistant has: it was revoked, expired, or lost a scope it needs. Make a new key on the radio's Access page with **Read** and **Control playback** (and **Stations** for Favor, Rest and Ban).

reconfigure.title: Change the radio's address or key
reconfigure.description: Use this when the radio has a new web address. It must be the same radio: one set up again has a new identity and needs to be added again.

error.invalid_address: That isn't a web address. Try https://lumae-radio.local:8443.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the radio. Check that it's on and on the same network as Home Assistant, then try again.
error.host_rejected: The radio doesn't answer to this address. Use the web address it was set up with, like https://lumae-radio.local:8443.
error.not_adopted: This radio has no owner yet. Set it up in the Lumae app first: Settings → Servers & accounts → Lumae Radio.
error.invalid_api_key: The radio didn't accept this API key. Copy it again, or make a new one.
error.missing_read: This API key can't read the radio. Make one with Read ticked.
error.missing_control: This API key can't control playback. Make one with Read and Control playback ticked.
error.identity_changed: The radio's identity changed since Home Assistant first saw it. If you set the radio up again, remove it here and add it again.

abort.already_configured: This radio is already in Home Assistant.
abort.not_lumae_radio: This isn't a Lumae Radio Home Assistant can use.
abort.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the radio. Check that it's on and on the same network as Home Assistant.
abort.host_rejected: The radio doesn't answer to the address it announced. Run its installer again.
abort.not_adopted: This radio has no owner yet. Set it up in the Lumae app first: Settings → Servers & accounts → Lumae Radio.
abort.reauth_successful: The radio accepts the new key.
abort.wrong_radio: That's a different radio, or this one was set up again. Add it as a new radio instead.

steer_track.name: Steer this track
steer_track.description: Favor, play less, rest or ban the track the radio is playing, on the station it plays it on. Your personal favorites, history and The Pulse stay as they are.

choice.name: Choice
choice.description: Favor and Less are gentle nudges. Rest keeps the track out for a while. Ban skips it now and never plays it on this station again.

rest_days.name: Rest for
rest_days.description: How long a rest lasts. A week if left out.

rest_until.name: Rest until
rest_until.description: When a rest ends, instead of a number of days.

radio_unreachable.message: Couldn't reach the radio. It keeps playing on its own; Home Assistant tries again.

api_key_rejected.message: The radio no longer accepts this API key. Add a new key in Home Assistant.

api_key_lacks_control.message: This API key can't control playback. Make a key with Read and Control playback.

api_key_lacks_scope.message: This API key can't do that. Make a key on the radio's Access page with the scopes it needs.

identity_changed.message: The radio's identity changed. If you set the radio up again, remove it from Home Assistant and add it again.

host_rejected.message: The radio doesn't answer to its saved address. Change the address in Home Assistant.

choose_station.message: Choose a station first: pick one as the source, or play one from Media.

nothing_to_steer.message: Nothing is playing on a station right now, so there's no track to steer.

steer_needs_stations_scope.message: This API key can't steer tracks. Make a key with Stations ticked, and add it in Home Assistant.
